scope: Scoped AI picture review of original-source scratch probes only. No human, domain, curriculum, production delivery or module-readiness claim.

aggregate_native_status.failure_reason: Both tiled variants extend their floor to the viewport sides; complete-scene checks failed. The full r01 aggregate remains failed and is preserved.

inspected.method: Viewed every 512px composition and every actual 704x250 native WordCard contact, then compared all four full composition images and contacts together.

ranking.name: compact-three-quarter
ranking.reason: Largest and clearest useful checkout group among the technically intact probes. Shopper on the goods side and green-uniformed employee behind the terminal frame a single station. The dark belt, terminal, carton and apple remain visible. No observed body/station penetration or implausible hand contact in this view. The real matched badge remains to the right of the group.
ranking.limits: At Match the fitted image is 67.75x52 within the 102x52 picture area. Grocery details are small; recognition depends on the whole interaction and equipment together. Matched alpha reduces contrast. This is scoped visual judgment, not a measured recognition study.

ranking.name: compact-high
ranking.reason: All local technical checks pass, and the lane stays coherent. More top-down projection makes the group taller and reduces its fitted Match width to 61.77px, making the roles and groceries smaller than the first view.

ranking.name: tiled-three-quarter
ranking.reason: The complete floor is clipped by the viewport. The floor fills substantial card area and reduces the scale of staff, shopper and station without adding a necessary meaning cue.

ranking.name: tiled-high
ranking.reason: The complete floor is clipped by the viewport; the top-down floor competes with the payment station and crowds the useful content further.

meaning_check.selected_meaning: The place in a store where purchases are paid for.
meaning_check.place_not_lone_object: One whole belt-and-terminal station connects a shopper presenting groceries with an employee on the staff side.
meaning_check.counter_distinction: The accepted counter image is a broad surface and parcel; this image adds payment equipment, grocery presentation and staff/customer roles.
meaning_check.cash_register_distinction: The station and interaction are the subject; no claim that the isolated machine has visible physical keys or a drawer base.
meaning_check.exclusions: No hotel/reception cues, readable words, brand marks, payment credentials, detached device close-up, invented geometry or replacement materials.

next_step: Root independently reviews the exact compact-three-quarter pixels and phone contacts. If accepted, preserve failed r01 and prepare an isolated final candidate/QA revision using the same source arrangement and camera before production delivery. No further native run without a separate root slot grant.
